defs.def: to make a young bird, fish, insect, etc. come out of an egg 使（小鸟、小鱼、小虫等）孵出
to create a plan or an idea, especially in secret 策划；（尤指）密谋

ex.s: Japan had hatched a plot to launch a surprise attack on Pearl Harbor, so the attack began without warning and without declaring war on the United States.
ex.t: 日本策划了一个阴谋，要对珍珠港发动突袭，所以这次袭击是在没有警告和未对美国宣战的情况下开始的。
